media_work.title: Southwest of Salem: The Story of the San Antonio Four
media_work.publisher_or_network: Sam Tabot Pictures, Naked Edge Films, Motto Pictures, Chicken & Egg Pictures
media_work.focus_or_theme: Wrongful conviction, "Satanic Panic," homophobia, unreliable child testimony, flawed forensic evidence.
media_work.summaryNotes: Awarded Peabody Award, GLAAD Award, Critic's Choice Award.

media_item.item_title: Southwest of Salem: The Story of the San Antonio Four
media_item.focus_or_theme: Wrongful conviction, "Satanic Panic," homophobia, unreliable child testimony, flawed forensic evidence.
media_item.summary_notes: Chronicles the decades-long fight of four women convicted based on unfounded accusations during the "Satanic Panic". Exposes how homophobia and flawed medical/child forensic interview practices contributed to their wrongful convictions. The film itself played a role in raising awareness and contributing to their eventual exoneration.

research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Examines case of four Latina lesbians wrongfully convicted; Themes include homophobia, "Satanic Panic," flawed forensics. Available via Amazon, Apple TV, DVD.
research_notes_other.research_findings: This documentary chronicles the decades-long fight of four women convicted based on unfounded accusations during the "Satanic Panic". It exposes how homophobia and flawed medical/child forensic interview practices contributed to their wrongful convictions. The film itself played a role in raising awareness and contributing to their eventual exoneration.

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Aggravated sexual assault of two young girls (Ramirez's nieces)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Wrongfully convicted of aggravated sexual assault of her nieces based on allegations arising during the "Satanic Panic" era, homophobic bias, coerced accusations, and flawed medical evidence. She served the longest time of the four women before being released on bond. She was fully exonerated in 2016.
contributing_factors_raw: Homophobic bias against the four lesbian women
Flawed and later recanted medical evidence
